language.name: Ledger Investigations
language.rationale: This design language embodies The Ledger's stark, ink-on-paper discipline, presenting information with high contrast and minimalist elegance directly over footage, aligning with a documentary aesthetic.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (compact density - 18/25px padding, 8px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule under the words, one clear space below them
surface: no surface - the words sit on the picture
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
over the picture: the heading (Ledger Investigations) reads 1.22:1 over a mid-tone shot (floor 3) - this graphic depends on the shot being kind
over the picture: the supporting line (Ledger Investigations) reads 1.14:1 over a mid-tone shot (floor 3) - this graphic depends on the shot being kind
